name: Polymorphist's Jest — "each creature target player controls loses all abilities and becomes a blue Frog with base power and toughness 1/1"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Only the ability loss was read: the type-setting parser turned the subject away because "target player controls" was followed by "loses all abilities and" instead of closing it. The Frog type, blue and 1/1 are now read and scoped to the chosen player like the ability loss. The opponent's Serra Angel is a blue 1/1 Frog with no abilities; your own Grizzly Bears is untouched.
